_about: Each leather chestplate the plugin has (LEATHER_CHESTPLATE): its custom model data, 10000 + its tile, 1 to 511; the look it wears, a file in armour/chest/ (or plain), dyed this colour where the file is grey; its inventory icon, an item model whose dyed layer (layer0) is coloured the same; and the shape of its body below the waist (none, fauld, jerkin, tunic). Chestplates and boots share the armour's first layer, a chestplate and the boots with its tile drawn on the same sheet tile. Add one with the next free custom model data, and the same number on the item in the plugin.
